rows.en: The desires of the people here are well worth setting loose.
Heh... We're already putting them to good use.
Ankh...? Ankh... You can't mean that Ankh...
He's a Greeed, same as us. Though all there is of him is an arm. Didn't anyone tell you?
You don't know? That's what this world is.
There are lots of "Cubes," and each one has a name of its own.
This one, for instance, is the "Begins Cube." It's a lot like the world we came from.
Still, there are some interesting desires swirling around in these "Cubes."
You don't know? That's what this world is.
There are lots of "Cubes," and each one has a name of its own.
There's something like an ice sculpture up ahead.
It looks like someone has been frozen inside.
On closer inspection, they turn out to be...
Maybe I could free them with Metal Branding...
No, that won't work. One wrong move and their bodies will shatter to pieces.
If I break the ice, could I save them?
No, that won't work. One wrong move and their bodies will shatter to pieces.
There has to be some way to save them...
If I set my beam rifle to minimum output...
No, that won't work. One wrong move and their bodies will shatter to pieces.
There has to be some way to save them...
If I set my beam rifle to minimum output...
No, that won't work. One wrong move and their bodies will shatter to pieces.
Think my Emerium Slash could bust them out?
No, that won't work. One wrong move and their bodies will shatter to pieces.
Trying to save them is useless. Rider 1 and Rider 2 have been cryogenically flash-frozen.
Without the proper equipment, those two will shatter to bits!
Oh-ho, looks like I've gotten famous. Well, I guess that's only natural...
After all, I went and launched the ultimate evil organization, one nobody's ever made before!!
Allow me to introduce...!! My minions!!
"The Ever-Victorious Evil Organization: Negataros Army (Working Title)"!!
...So anyway, we're an organization built to hunt you heroes down.
We're an organization built to hunt you heroes down!
Worthless ones get wiped out on the spot! Valuable ones get nabbed and kept on ice!
So we can use 'em as lab rats!!
You lot look valuable. Take my advice and quietly let us freeze you!

notes.note: Branch for a party without OOO: Kazari brushes off Ankh's absence (answers story_007 #0.34). #0.36-0.39 repeat the Greeed exchange from #0.13-0.16 of story_007 for this branch.
Philip seems to have heard of Ankh ('surely that...'); rendered as recognition trailing off.
Ankh referred to as 'he' per glossary g=m. 'Only an arm' = his form is just an arm.

Party echoes Kazari's line about desires in the 'Cubes' (story_007 #0.12 / this slice #0.59). Rendered plural 'Cubes' to match what they heard. Event order in the extract is out of sequence (branch tables).
Source had a trailing line break; dropped.
Same line reused for each party member. Subject of the conditional (whoever interferes) left implicit via 'One wrong move'; 'their bodies' = Rider 1 and 2.
Emerium Slash is Zero's established English attack name (Ultraman Wiki).
Literally: only a dedicated device can do it; otherwise the two shatter. Compressed to 'Without the proper equipment'.
Arrogant self-reference rendered as 'the great Negataros'.
proofread: Siamese Cat Yummy cry aligned with the same roar in story_009-012 (Mreeeeeooow!!).
No speaker recovered; Negataros continues his roll call (pattern of #0.57/#0.59/#0.63).
No speaker recovered; Skullma's laugh responding to his introduction.
Group name not in glossary: rendered 'Negataros Army' (gundan); the provisional-name tag rendered '(Working Title)'. Recurs in story_009 #0.92 - suggest adding to glossary.
No speaker recovered; alternate-branch copy of Negataros's line #0.67.
'Kept on ice' = cryo-preserved (literal freezing, as with Rider 1 and 2).

report: 80/80 rows examined. Speakers inferred for #0.61 (Negataros), #0.62 (Skullma), #0.68 (Negataros, alt branch). New term not in glossary: 'Negataros Army'. Attack names used: Metal Branding, Emerium Slash.
